subject: Triggered early-sweep clause + payment routing / VAT evidence
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@hydrabio.it>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: HydraBio Finance <finance@hydrabio.it>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 +0200
Subject: Triggered early-sweep clause — routing to EU entity and VAT docs

Hi Naomi,

Hope you're well. Quick ask from our side as we look to accelerate collections for Q3: per Section 6.2 of the MSA we have an internal trigger that allows us to sweep outstanding balances when receivables exceed EUR 150k. We want to pilot that behaviour starting next month, but with two adjustments:

- Route all invoice remits for the sweep to our EU billing entity (HydraBio S.r.l.) instead of the US HQ.
- Provide VAT registration evidence + proof of reverse-charge eligibility (we'll share our VAT cert shortly).

Two practical items we need Redwood to confirm before we flip the switch:
1) Can you confirm you can change the payment routing in your billing system so swept invoices are addressed to HydraBio S.r.l. and include the EU VAT number on the invoice PDF?
2) If we enable early-sweep, will your team accept Net30 on swept invoices (we prefer earlier payment windows) or will that force a contract amendment to Net45/Net60?

Also — given the accelerated cadence — we'll likely need a short-term uplift in our credit ceiling (estimate +EUR 200k) to avoid payment churn while the pilot runs. Please let me know what evidence you need for that and the typical SLA for credit-limit decisions.

Attached: INV-2026-06-789.pdf (outstanding), sample remittance file.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Finance Lead, HydraBio
Attachment: INV-2026-06-789.pdf (invoice, 1.2MB)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@hydrabio.it>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 11:02:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Triggered early-sweep clause — routing to EU entity and VAT docs

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear note and the invoice. We're open to running a short pilot for the sweep but need to align on tax routing and credit guardrails. Quick summary of what we can do and what we need from you:

What we can support immediately:
- Payment routing: we can update the remit-to/payee name on future invoices to HydraBio S.r.l. and include the VAT number in the invoice header. That requires a signed PO or a channel-confirmed remit instruction from your procurement team.
- Early-sweep pilot: we can enable a conditional sweep for subscription/usage line items only (not professional services) for 60 days as a pilot. During that period we'll keep original invoice numbers but add a "sweep" transaction note.

What we need from you before we enable the pilot:
1) HydraBio_VAT_certificate.pdf (official VAT registration) — needed to support EU invoicing and any reverse-charge treatment.
2) A confirmation email from Procurement/Accounts Payable authorizing the routing change, or a PO that references the MSA and authorizes HydraBio S.r.l. as remit-to.
3) For the credit ceiling uplift: completed credit request form + last 3 months of bank/AR aging (we can accept an AP-led confirmation in lieu of full bank statements for pilot).

Proposed commercial safety: if you want Net30 on swept invoices, we treat those as accelerated receivables and will require a conditional processing fee (0.7% of swept amount) to cover short-term funding. Absent that fee, invoices default to Net45 under the current billing policy.

Internal next steps: Kimberly — can you confirm VAT/legal checklist for routing to an Italian entity (reverse-charge vs. VAT on our side)? Marcus — please review the credit uplift ask and give me an initial TAT.

I've attached our internal "early_sweep_playbook.pdf" to show how we log sweep transactions in recording and remittance.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Manager, Finance Operations — Redwood Inference
Attachment: early_sweep_playbook.pdf (PDF, 420KB)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 10:45:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Triggered early-sweep clause — routing to EU entity and VAT docs

Naomi / Marcus — quick tax/legal note:

- Routing invoices to HydraBio S.r.l. is fine provided their VAT registration is valid and they are the contracting entity for the specific purchase in scope. If HydraBio S.r.l. is not a signatory to the MSA, we need a short amendment/letter of assignment (one paragraph) that records the remit-to change and confirms which legal entity is responsible for VAT.
- Reverse-charge: as long as the EU entity provides a valid VAT number and states the purpose (B2B supply of digital services), we can invoice without charging VAT and expose the reverse-charge line on the invoice. We'll store the VAT cert in the customer tax profile.
- For swept invoices showing an early payment window (Net30), our accounting will record the transaction as an accelerated receivable; that may affect revenue recognition timing — revenue ops will want to see the pilot duration and expected volumes.

Action items for external: ask HydraBio to send the VAT cert (ideally registered name + number + issuing authority) and a signed one-line remit amendment (I can draft).

KM
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
From: Elena Rossi <elena@hydrabio.it>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: HydraBio Finance <finance@hydrabio.it>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2026 16:02:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Triggered early-sweep clause — routing to EU entity and VAT docs

Naomi / Kimberly / Marcus — thanks for the quick turnaround.

We can provide everything requested: attached is HydraBio_VAT_certificate.pdf (registered name + VAT IT123456789), and I've asked Procurement to send the signed remit amendment by COB Monday. We'll also push the credit uplift materials to you (AP confirmation + AR aging) — target to get to you by Tuesday.

On the Net terms: HydraBio would prefer to keep commercial terms at Net45 to preserve internal payment cadence; however we would like the operational benefit of the early-sweep pilot (i.e., automatic transfer of funds to the EU remit entity). If a processing fee is necessary for Net30 we are not asking for that now — let's keep Net45 and run the sweep pilot for two months. If volumes and cashflow performance are stable after the pilot, we'll consider Net30 as part of a billing amendment.

Please route the swept invoices to:
HydraBio S.r.l.
VAT IT123456789
Bank details: (placeholder, will be on remittance file)

Elena
Elena Rossi
Finance Lead, HydraBio
Attachment: HydraBio_VAT_certificate.pdf (PDF, 180KB)
